intro: Designed for those who appreciate beauty and practicality, Grande is a masterful blend of Sheesham's charm and modern storage. Its minimalism and durability transform your bedroom into a sanctuary.

features.title: Minimalist beauty for effortless living
features.text: The natural wood grain of Sheesham adds a rustic yet sophisticated aesthetic, making your bedroom a serene and stylish retreat.

features.title: Resistant to warping and decay
features.text: Crafted from seasoned Sheesham wood, this bed is resistant to warping, decay, and insect damage, ensuring a long-lasting and worry-free investment.

features.title: Box storage for organised living
features.text: The built-in box storage provides ample space for storing bedding, clothes, and essentials, keeping your room neat and clutter-free.

features.title: Made from sheesham wood
features.text: With antibacterial properties and resistance to warping, the solid Sheesham wood construction offers both strength and sustainability, aligning with modern eco-friendly values.

features.title: Spacious headboard with functional ledge
features.text: The headboard features a functional ledge, perfect for placing bedtime essentials or displaying personal accents, combining utility with style.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
